text:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — AstraTech wants a live POC next Wed. They plan to run a simulated user load from their infra: ~200 concurrent clients, short chat requests, streaming enabled. Ask: temporary hosted QPS bump and an ephemeral scoped key for the demo.

 tom_sales: ETA for the demo window? they'll need the key before Monday to run integration tests.

 sarah_sales: Demo window requested: 2026-06-17 18:30-19:00 UTC (30m). They want the key Friday EOD.

 rachel_sre: 200 clients with streaming could hit ~1200 RPS peak depending on client rate. A few clarifying q's: 1) avg messages/sec per client? 2) region? 3) do they require guaranteed throughput or can we use graceful degradation?

 tom_sales: avg ~6 messages/min per client (they use typing burst) so estimate ~120 RPS sustained, but spikes to 1200 for interactive phase. Region: eu-west-1. Degradation: they prefer automatic model fallback but will accept reduced throughput message.

 rachel_sre: Ok. We can do an ephemeral scoped key with a burst cap. Options: hosted burst up to 1300 RPS for a 40m window with token cap, or recommend Dedicated pool pre-warm (reservable) if they need guaranteed tails. Dedicated requires contract lead time.

 jane_se: I can create the scoped key if finance signs off on token allowance. For hosted option propose: - allowed_models: [redwood-chat-lg, redwood-chat-small] - qps: 1300 - window: 2026-06-17T18:20:00Z/2026-06-17T19:00:00Z - total_token_limit: 250000000 - streaming: true

 quota-bot: Request recorded: TEMP_QPS_BURST by sarah_sales for AstraTech. Request ID: TR-2068002222. Status: awaiting_approval.

 luis_finance: Need a rough cost estimate to approve. Can you share projected token usage and confirm whether streaming adds additional billing? Tagging @finance.

 tom_sales: Rough calc: assume worst-case spike sustained for 10m: 1200 RPS * 80 tokens * 600s = ~57,600,000 tokens during spike. Add baseline 120 RPS for remaining 20m -> ~19,200,000. Total ~76.8M tokens. Add 10% buffer ~85M. Streaming billed same per-token AFAIK.

 rachel_sre: To reduce token usage, enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts and set max_output_tokens per request to 150. Also set an automatic fallback route: if 95p latency > 800ms OR error_rate > 1.5% route to redwood-chat-small. We'll monitor via live telemetry.

 jane_se: Sharing example client snippet for AstraTech engineers (replace <SCOPED_KEY>):

 ```
 curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-lg","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}' \
   https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/stream
 ```

 jane_se: Scopes I'll attach: allowed_endpoints=[/v1/chat,/v1/embeddings], ip_allowlist if requested, telemetry_tag=AstraTech-demo. Will expire key automatically at window end.

 luis_finance: Put a soft token cap of 100M and produce a cost estimate. I'll review and reply by EOD Thursday. If approved, jane_se can generate the key.

 rachel_sre: I'll pre-warm redwood-chat-small on eu-west-1 and create dashboard tiles: qps, 95p latency, error_rate, token_consumption. Alert to #eng-oncall and the sales thread if thresholds tripped.

 sarah_sales: Great. Please confirm once quota-bot flips to approved. AstraTech expects the key Friday EOD; they will test on Saturday morning. :thumbsup:

 quota-bot: Update TR-2068002222 -> status: pending_finance_review.
